title: Type 2 Diabetes and Diet: A UK Guide That Actually Helps
excerpt: 1 in 4 UK adults now live with diabetes or prediabetes. Here's what the evidence says about food, blood sugar and remission.
author: Bite Insight Team
meta_title: Type 2 Diabetes Diet: A UK Guide to Food & Blood Sugar
meta_description: 5.6 million people in the UK live with diabetes. Here's what NHS and NICE guidance says about diet, blood sugar control and remission.
ai_summary: Type 2 diabetes affects over 5.6 million people in the UK, with 90% of cases being type 2. This guide explains what NHS and NICE guidance actually recommends for managing blood sugar through food, debunks the myth that sugar alone causes diabetes, and covers the plate method plus the DiRECT trial evidence showing that structured weight loss can put type 2 diabetes into remission for some people.
